data.explanation: This is a regular invoice for office supplies you ordered. It states you should pay the total amount by the stated deadline. Note that the invoice also prints a separate "Fälligkeitsdatum" (due date) one week later than the payment instruction in the text — check with the seller which one actually applies. As today is well past both dates, this invoice appears overdue; pay it as soon as possible using the reference BB-4471 to avoid reminders or late fees, or contact the seller if you already paid or dispute the amount.
